newsitem.title: CHINA: China to keep urban unemployment at 3 pct in '97.
newsitem.headline: China to keep urban unemployment at 3 pct in '97.

text.p: China has set a target of controlling urban unemployment at three percent in 1997, major newspapers said on Thursday.
The government would create 8.0 million jobs in urban areas next year, the People's Daily and the Securities Daily said, quoting a conference on labour affairs in Beijing.
It would also relocate 2.5 million jobless people, the newspapers said without giving any further details.
China's urban unemployment was 2.9 percent in 1995, according to official figures.
Many state-run firms are heavily overstaffed but these people do not show up in official statistics.
